title: SQL built by concatenation (apex) — review required
description: A apex query call assembles SQL from parts: Database.querys*((?:[^()]|([^()]*))*+. If any part is untrusted input, the query structure itself is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Parameterize with Database.queryWithBinds in user mode so input stays data; never interpolate values into SQL text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.

tests.line: Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = ' + name)

List<Account> a = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = :name');
